blocks.text: I need to move our check-in next week. I am out Monday and Tuesday for a licensing exam, so let us push it to Thursday morning. Ten o'clock holds on my end, and I have kept the small conference room we usually take.

One other thing while I am out those two days. I have asked the front desk to route my calls to you, and they have put you down as Jeffrey Ochoa on the coverage sheet, so nothing should fall through. It should be quiet, but I did not want a message sitting unanswered.
If Thursday does not work, tell me and I will find another slot.
